summary: Larimar Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting the submission of the first module of a rolling Biologics License Application to the FDA for accelerated approval of nomlabofusp for Friedreich's ataxia, along with positive open-label study data. No M&A or special situation transactions were announced; the filing is a routine regulatory and clinical update. It includes a press release and investor presentation, with no deal terms or structural changes. The event is purely operational, not a special situation.
